tessa_sales: Heads-upClient: MediBridge (enterprise, HIPAA). They want a 12mo commit. Estimate: ~12M tokens/mo, peak ~720 concurrent short chats, 95th <=250ms. Ask: reserved GPUs + burst credits + autoscale recs. Can eng/sre/pricing/security advise? Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-1722 :wave:

omar_eng: Quick clarifiers: 720 concurrent = in-flight reqs? avg prompt+resp tokens? model constraints?

tessa_sales: Yes in-flight. Avg response+prompt ~400 tokens. They accept 4-bit quantized open models. Embeddings small (nightly batch).

omar_eng: Rough throughput A100-like ~=120 RPS at 400 tokens (quantized). Baseline GPUs = ceil(720/120)=6. Recommend 6 reserved for baseline. Add 50% burst headroom for 20-30m spikes -> +3 GPUs burst pool. Plan = 6 reserved + 3 burst (autoscale to 9). Spread across 2 AZs. KV cache prefill needed.

nina_sre: Autoscale suggestion for Dedicated config:
{ "min_replicas": 6, "max_replicas": 9, "scale_metric": "concurrent_requests", "target_per_replica": 120, "scale_up_cooldown_s": 45, "scale_down_cooldown_s": 240, "burst_pool": 3 }

vik_pricing: Need ballpark for SOW (reserved 12mo vs on-demand).

omar_eng: Ballpark math: reserved A100-equiv $7,000/GPU-mo -> 6*$7k = $42k baseline. Burst credits priced ~35% when consumed; if bursts used 10% month: 3*$7k*0.35*0.1 ~= $735. Add support/compliance margin ~15% => rough monthly ~$50k. Finance to finalize.

maya_sec: HIPAA items: BAA, CMK, VPC peering, audit logs export 365d. Private or Dedicated+VPC peering OK. I'll prepare checklist and ping Legal for BAA.

runbook_bot: [runbook] created OP-9011 preheat + smoke tasks assigned to @nina_sre.

tessa_sales: Thanks all I'll put 6x reserved +3x burst in draft SOW and schedule a handoff call with MediBridge Thu 10am PT. Closing thread. :handshake:
